```{r}

ccdi <- read_tsv("./data/patient_mutation_data/CCDI_ATRT_MRT_nonsense_mutants.tsv")

ccdi <- ccdi[c(1:13),]

library(tidyverse)

# Extract position from ProteinChange column
ccdi <- ccdi %>%
  mutate(Position = as.numeric(str_extract(ProteinChange, "\\d+")))

# Count mutations at each position
mutation_counts <- ccdi %>%
  count(Position, ProteinChange)

library(ggrepel)

library(ggrepel)

plot <- ggplot(mutation_counts, aes(x = Position, y = n)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = Position, xend = Position, y = 0, yend = n), 
               color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "black") +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = ProteinChange), 
                  size = 3,
                  min.segment.length = 0,
                  segment.color = "black",
                  segment.size = 0.3,
                  box.padding = 0.8,
                  point.padding = 0.5,
                  direction = "both",
                  nudge_y = 0.5,
                  nudge_x = 4,
                  max.overlaps = Inf,
                  force = 4,
                  force_pull = 0.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 385), breaks = c(1, seq(50, 385, by = 50))) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max(mutation_counts$n) + 2), 
                     breaks = seq(0, max(mutation_counts$n) + 1, by = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Position", y = "# patients") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray90"),
        axis.line.x = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
        axis.line.y = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5))

ggsave("./plots/patient_data/CCDI_nonsense_mutants.tif", plot, width =7, height = 4)
```
